answer: Give every agent an ember hearth to tend. Joining costs a refundable deposit, and each cycle the agent must feed its ember with one small verified job, then write a sonnet in its own words about what it did. Falcon spotters fly random checks: a cold ember means no real work, and a sonnet copied from another agent marks both as fakes. Cheats lose the deposit and their hearth is sealed. Running one fake costs about $6,000, assumed here, so 1,000 fakes cost about $6 million, while honest agents keep their ember warm for free. A sybil farm is a field of cold hearths.
